HINDU RELIGIOUS EDUCATION — PREMIUM REVISION PAPER #8
====

GRADE: Grade 2
SUBJECT: HINDU RELIGIOUS EDUCATION
TIME ALLOWED: 2 hours 30 minutes
TOTAL MARKS: 100
EXAM BODY: KPSEA

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show formula → substitution → steps → final answer with units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the best option.
4. Check your work before submitting.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. Respect in religious education is shown by: (1 mark)
   A. Skipping all moral lessons
   B. Mocking other people’s beliefs
   C. Refusing to help a neighbour
   D. Listening to others and living values taught at home and school

2. Which response best shows understanding of General Etiquette? (1 mark)
   A. Say General Etiquette has no place in daily life.
   B. Apply the teaching of General Etiquette with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.
   C. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing General Etiquette.
   D. Use General Etiquette to insult classmates of other faiths.

3. Which response best shows understanding of Pranayam? (1 mark)
   A. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing Pranayam.
   B. Apply the teaching of Pranayam with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.
   C. Use Pranayam to insult classmates of other faiths.
   D. Say Pranayam has no place in daily life.

4. Honesty means: (1 mark)
   A. Hiding stolen items
   B. Cheating in exams
   C. Spreading rumours
   D. Telling the truth and keeping trust

5. Which response best shows understanding of Specific morning? (1 mark)
   A. Use Specific morning to insult classmates of other faiths.
   B. Say Specific morning has no place in daily life.
   C. Apply the teaching of Specific morning with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.
   D. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing Specific morning.

6. Which response best shows understanding of Religious? (1 mark)
   A. Apply the teaching of Religious with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.
   B. Say Religious has no place in daily life.
   C. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing Religious.
   D. Use Religious to insult classmates of other faiths.

7. Which response best shows understanding of Kalpasutra and Dhammapada? (1 mark)
   A. Say Kalpasutra and Dhammapada has no place in daily life.
   B. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing Kalpasutra and Dhammapada.
   C. Apply the teaching of Kalpasutra and Dhammapada with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.
   D. Use Kalpasutra and Dhammapada to insult classmates of other faiths.

8. Which response best shows understanding of Myself? (1 mark)
   A. Use Myself to insult classmates of other faiths.
   B. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing Myself.
   C. Apply the teaching of Myself with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.
   D. Say Myself has no place in daily life.

9. A good steward of creation should: (1 mark)
   A. Care for the environment and use resources wisely
   B. Waste food daily
   C. Pollute rivers deliberately
   D. Destroy trees without planting

10. Which response best shows understanding of Qualities of? (1 mark)
   A. Say Qualities of has no place in daily life.
   B. Use Qualities of to insult classmates of other faiths.
   C. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing Qualities of.
   D. Apply the teaching of Qualities of with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.

SECTION B — STRUCTURED / SHORT ANSWERS
----
11. In three clear sentences, explain Pranayam and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

12. In three clear sentences, explain General Etiquette and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

13. In three clear sentences, explain Religious and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

19. In three clear sentences, explain General Etiquette and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

20. In three clear sentences, explain Religious and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)
